sentences.en: The teacher explained the situational use of idioms in class.
sentences.zh: 老师在课堂上解释了成语的语境使用。

sentences.en: Her confidence grew as she became more familiar with the situational challenges.
sentences.zh: 随着她对情境挑战越来越熟悉，她的信心也增加了。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a menu that is tailored to the situational needs of its customers.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅提供一份根据顾客需求定制的情境菜单。

senses.zh: 情形的，情景的；(个人行为起因) 由具体环境形成的
